desc: An old night-watchman with dark brown skin and a short white beard: a long grey coat to the knees, a red scarf, a tall dark felt hat and heavy black boots.

skins.name: Old night-watchman
skins.who: An old night-watchman who walks the fair rows after dark, checking stall shutters and lamps.
skins.body: A tall dark charcoal felt hat, worn soft and slightly dusty at the crown, with a deep oxblood band; short cropped white-grey hair shows at the back of the neck below the brim. A thick red wool scarf wraps the neck, its tails hanging down the chest and back, with a few loose threads and a faded patch where it rubs. A long heavy grey wool coat runs to the knees, darker and scuffed at the hem and cuffs, its seams lightly picked out, with a small neat darn on the left breast. A worn dark brown leather belt with a round brass buckle sits at the waist, and a small dented brass flask hangs at the right hip; dark charcoal trousers show below. Heavy black boots with folded cuffs, creased and dull at the toes, and the hands are dark brown, knuckly and lined.
skins.face: An old man in his late sixties with dark brown skin, deep forehead lines and creases around the eyes, soft bags beneath them, and a small dark mole on one cheek. Dark brown eyes under heavy lids, thick white brows, full muted lips, and a short neat white beard. The expression is calm and watchful, the mouth closed.

skins.name: Chestnut roaster
skins.who: A cheerful middle-aged man who roasts chestnuts over a brazier at the fair gate.
skins.body: A tall tan felt hat, faded lighter on the crown and smudged with soot near the brim, with a moss green band; short copper-red hair shows at the back of the neck. A cream wool scarf with wide mustard stripes wraps the neck, its tails hanging front and back, flecked with small scorch marks. A long moss green coat to the knees, its hem and cuffs darkened with soot and ash, with a brown corduroy patch on the right elbow and a row of small dark horn buttons painted down the chest. A mid-brown leather belt with a round brass buckle, a small brass flask at the right hip polished bright from handling, and dark brown trousers below. Brown leather boots with folded cuffs, ash-grey at the toes, and the hands are pale, freckled and pink at the knuckles from the heat.
skins.face: A man in his late thirties with pale, ruddy skin, rosy cheeks and nose, and a scatter of freckles across both. Bright green eyes, thick copper brows, thin lips, faint laugh lines at the eye corners, and a short trimmed copper-red beard. The expression is calm and friendly, the mouth closed.
